data.title: What data we process
data.body: When you sign in with Lesta ID: the Mir Tankov account ID and nickname and a Lesta API access token. If you provide them: your email address and Telegram ID. If you bound the modpack: your battle results, your shots, tank loadouts, queue times, game settings (when you send them), replays (if you turned uploads on) and the device key. For the modpack plate the mod sends the account numbers of a battle’s players: the site keeps no copy of that list and, while the switch is on, keeps only a 30-day “mod installed” mark on your account. For the Plus subscription: payment history and subscription status; card data is handled by the payment provider, we never receive or store it. Public game statistics come from the open Lesta API.

purposes.title: Why
purposes.body: To show your statistics and analytics, keep your settings, goals and favorites, send the notifications you turned on, and run the Plus subscription.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: The consent you give when you sign in and turn on notifications, and performance of the contract (terms of use and public offer), under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data”.

storage.title: Where and how long data is stored
storage.body: Data is stored on servers in the Russian Federation: <todo>hosting provider and region</todo>. We keep it while you have an account and delete it right after the account is deleted, except payment records the law requires us to keep longer. Battle results and sessions from the modpack are kept for up to 2 years.

transfer.title: Who receives data
transfer.body: The payment provider <todo>payment provider name</todo>, to take payments; the email provider, for the emails you turned on; Telegram and Discord, only if you connected the bot or session reports. Data is never sold or shared for advertising.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can get a copy of your data, correct it, withdraw consent and delete your account in your account area (the Overview page). Send requests the interface cannot handle to <mail>{email}</mail>; we reply within 10 business days.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: We use a session cookie to keep you signed in, a technical device cookie with a random identifier to count free allowances without signing in (such as 3D armor views), and browser local storage for theme, language and display settings. Analytics services: <todo>list, if any</todo>.

subject.title: Subject
subject.body: Three Marks is an unofficial fan-made statistics and tools service for Mir Tankov. It is not affiliated with Lesta Games; game data comes from the open Lesta API. The core features are free.

account.title: Account
account.body: You sign in with Lesta ID or Telegram. We never receive or store your game password. You are responsible for actions taken in your account and can delete it at any time in your account area (the Overview page).

plus.title: The Plus subscription
plus.body: Three Marks Plus is a paid subscription that raises limits and unlocks extra features. Some features are free within a monthly allowance (for example 3D armor and detailed battle analysis); allowances follow the calendar month and renew on the 1st at 00:00 Moscow time. The subscription's contents, allowances, prices and periods are listed on the Plus page and form part of this offer. Paying for the subscription means accepting the offer.

payment.title: Payment and renewal
payment.body: Payments are processed by <todo>payment provider name</todo>. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn auto-renewal off under “Subscription”. A fiscal receipt is sent to your email under Russian Federal Law No. 54-FZ.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.body: You can cancel at any time: turn auto-renew off under “Subscription”, and access stays until the end of the paid period. The paid period is not refunded automatically: we refund the unused days on your request — write to <mail>{email}</mail> or the <bot>bot</bot>. The money goes back the way you paid, within 10 days of the request.

rules.title: Acceptable use
rules.body: Do not scrape the site around the public API, disrupt the service, publish other people’s data without consent, or break the Mir Tankov rules. The Three Marks modpack shows only your own data and what the game client already shows.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is”. Statistics are computed from the Lesta API and may differ from in-game figures. We are not liable for Lesta API outages or for decisions made based on the statistics.

termsChanges.title: Changes to the terms
termsChanges.body: A new version takes effect when published on this page. For active subscriptions, price changes apply from the next period. Version date: <todo>date</todo>.

dataErrors.title: Wrong data

game.title: Game support (Lesta)
game.body: Game account questions, in-game purchases, bans and Lesta ID are handled only by Lesta Games support: <lesta>Lesta support center</lesta>. We cannot help with them because we are not affiliated with Lesta Games.
